metadata.description: Open-source skills for founder-led short-form content, one plugin per playbook published on statur.co.

plugins.name: content-testing-loop
plugins.description: Make every short video teach the next one: video post-mortem, format dice review and monthly learning session.

plugins.name: social-analytics
plugins.description: Own your short-form analytics: collect views, retention and audience from TikTok, Instagram, Facebook and YouTube into plain files your AI can query, watch competitor accounts and keep proof screenshots.

plugins.name: statur-clipping
plugins.description: Turn lives, webinars, long videos or a Google Drive folder into ready-to-post vertical clips: transcription, clip plan, edit, quality check and review page.

plugins.name: video-script-structure
plugins.description: Map the story structure of long or short videos sentence by sentence, then write scripts on your own subject that replay it, with parity and fact checks.

plugins.name: comment-section
plugins.description: Plan comment traps that spread an idea, read live comment sections and draft disclosed founder comments.

plugins.name: organic-to-paid
plugins.description: Turn proven organic short-form videos into ad creatives and test them against the current best ad.

plugins.name: creative-led-growth
plugins.description: Coach a founder through creative-led growth: one channel, one hour a day, packaging and share rate.

plugins.name: creator-programs
plugins.description: Design, run and audit a creator program paid on performance.

plugins.name: x-launch-playbook
plugins.description: Plan a launch week on X judged on business numbers.

plugins.name: tradespeople-video
plugins.description: One video per job and an AI morning routine for tradespeople, with scripts, setup and admin processes.

plugins.name: format-library
plugins.description: Pick, script and read twelve short-form formats for founders.

plugins.name: content-os
plugins.description: Set up a private AI content operating system in a company from the public blueprint.

plugins.name: scale-meta-ads
plugins.description: Scale Meta ads without cost inflation: diagnosis, one purchase campaign, live ads sized to the budget, test lane, partnership ads, offers and statics, weekly and monthly reads.
